text: The small signaling molecules that bacteria produce and release, which accumulate in the environment in proportion to cell density and are detected to trigger density-dependent gene expression, are collectively called ___.
explanation: The answer is 'autoinducers.' The name reflects that the signal induces its own production through positive feedback. Major classes include acyl-homoserine lactones (AHLs) in Gram-negative bacteria, autoinducing peptides (AIPs) in Gram-positives, and AI-2, produced by many species.
